displayQuote: Every moment is a fresh beginning

meta.title: Who really said "Every moment is a fresh beginning"? | Quotle.info
meta.description: This line is genuinely T.S. Eliot's — spoken by the character Edward in Act III of his 1949 play The Cocktail Party, not a free-floating proverb.
meta.ogTitle: Who really said 'Every moment is a fresh beginning'?
meta.ogDescription: Traced to Act III of T.S. Eliot's The Cocktail Party (1949/1950) — spoken by the character Edward, not a stray inspirational proverb.

answer.label: Written by
answer.sourceLine: The line is spoken by the character Edward in Act III of Eliot’s verse play The Cocktail Party (first performed 1949, published 1950). Quote-reference pages that catalogue the play line-by-line consistently place it there, with no rival claimant turning up anywhere in the record.

source.heading: The source

docMeta.dd: 22 August 1949 (Edinburgh Festival) · published 1950, Faber & Faber (UK) / Harcourt, Brace (US)

source.excerpt: Every moment is a fresh beginning.
trail: Widely reproduced today as a stand-alone inspirational proverb, stripped of its speaker and dramatic context, e.g. on Goodreads ↗.
Wikiquote’s dedicated, act-by-act breakdown of The Cocktail Party attributes the line specifically to the character Edward in Act III: see Wikiquote ↗.
A second independent compilation of the play’s dialogue corroborates the same line from the same play: see MagicalQuote ↗.
source.excerptNote: Spoken by Edward in Act III, following an exchange in which the psychiatrist Reilly tells another character, “Only by acceptance / Of the past will you alter its meaning.”

source.rightsHolder: Estate of T. S. Eliot / Faber & Faber (UK) and Harcourt, Brace and Company, later Houghton Mifflin Harcourt (US)
source.rightsNote: The Cocktail Party was first performed in 1949 and published in 1950, decades after the 1930 cutoff, so the play text — and this line from it — remains in copyright, held by Eliot’s estate and his publishers.

author.name: T. S. Eliot
author.heading: About T. S. Eliot
author.metaLine: 1888–1965 · American-born British poet, playwright, essayist & Nobel laureate
author.bio: Thomas Stearns Eliot is one of the towering figures of 20th-century English-language literature, known for The Waste Land, Four Quartets, and The Love Song of J. Alfred Prufrock. He also wrote verse dramas, including the Tony Award-winning The Cocktail Party, and won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1948.
